raios.comment: LOCAL ONLY. One Universal MCP on census port 8788. Streamable HTTP session channel: POST /mcp JSON-RPC, GET /mcp SSE, mcp-session-id on initialize. Loopback clients may call read tools without a token. Writes need an actor grant. Do not start :8787 as a second server. ChatGPT Apps need public HTTPS or a Secure MCP Tunnel in front of this SAME process. REAL_C2_CONNECTION_READY remains false until an external C2 posts an opinion. Copy to .cursor/mcp.json to bind Cursor. Reload Cursor MCP after the server process restarts.
